title: RoC Skincare aims to rank among France's top 3 anti-aging brands
summary: Two years after its comeback to the French market, dermocosmetics brand RoC Skincare achieved 500% sell-out growth in 2025, and is forecasting a 200% increase in 2026. This performance reflects an ambitious relaunch strategy across Europe. Read on for more.
